reasoning: Hamas has historically refused to disarm, viewing armed resistance as central to its identity and mission. As of early March 2026, there's no indication Hamas would make such a dramatic policy reversal within ~25 days. Even amid ongoing conflict and pressure, Hamas leadership has consistently rejected disarmament demands. A formal announcement to disarm would represent an unprecedented capitulation that contradicts decades of organizational doctrine. While ceasefire negotiations may be ongoing, agreeing to disarm is fundamentally different from temporary truces. The probability is extremely low.
